snippet.title: The Dream Files Just Dropped
snippet.description:
In 2023 Dream opened an 82-minute video by saying honesty and truth were his top priority. I went back through six years of him getting caught, from the 2020 speedrun to the pinned comment that says his Manhunt server has "increasing pearl rates", and almost every time it goes the same way: he denies it, he goes after the person who caught him, and later a smaller version comes out with a reason attached.

What's in it: the 1-in-7.5-trillion speedrun, the paid astrophysicist and the 4 a.m. confession; The Truth; the broken wrist, the "obscure ways to practice" and the private message Karl Jobst says Dream sent him ("I did use aimbot after my surgery"); the MCC parkour accusations; the Technoblade duel, where Dream was right; the world records that went private; the Manhunts: the seeds, the 46 hidden cuts, "the same way I disguise cuts in the main video", the custom server JAR and the happy ghast; the friend in both stories; Karl walking away; and the full scoreboard of all six rounds, including the case for Dream.

The findings belong to the people who made them and are credited on screen: the speedrun moderators (Geosquare), Matt Parker (Stand-up Maths), Karl Jobst, MrMangoHands, Eliotex, Glestic, Ham Sandwiches, Dart Spark and his team, masterwyatt and the seed crackers, Erdgeist After Dark, Cheeseburger, BjorkMinecraft, Tayler, Kenadian, scriptline, Skeppy, fireborn, Blissolic, Kart and Cubfan135. Dream's own words are from his videos, streams, Shorts, Reddit replies and pinned FAQ, and his WIRED interview. The aimbot message is the screenshot Karl Jobst published; Dream has not publicly confirmed or denied it. Cubfan135's Mojang story is his account. Nobody has proven the MCC parkour was cheated, and on the Technoblade duel the evidence doesn't hold up; both are in the video.

The Truth (2023) was mostly Dream's answer to the allegations against him that year, which he denies; this video doesn't cover them.

Clips are used for commentary and criticism.

snippet.description:
Insane to think something that started in the petri dish of knights of Columbus halls could end up at soldier field. Honestly, insane.

Next year join us as we for the biggest version of this art project yet: Twilight of the Punks. 

The Offspring, Good Charlotte, and The Story So Far are coming along for the ride in North America. A Day To Remember and Neck Deep will be joining us in Europe and the UK. Pre-sale starts Wednesday, sign up on twilightofthepunkstour.com

We wanted to create a song that could be a soundtrack for this moment. 

ACES is out now: https://FallOutBoy.lnk.to/ACES 

See you out there 🖤

TWILIGHT OF THE PUNKS 

PRE-SALES
EU* / UK pre-sale begins Wed 11 Nov @ noon local time
*Lyon, Paris, Lodz, Brussels pre-sale begins Thur 12 Nov @ noon local time
North America pre-sale begins Wed Nov 11 @ 10am local time

ON SALES
EU* / UK general on sale begins Thur 12 Nov @ noon local time
*Lyon, Paris, Lodz, Brussels general on sale begins Fri 13 Nov @ noon local time
North America general on sale begins Thur Nov 12 @ 10am local time
